turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Good morning, thanks so much for making time today. I know you mentioned last week you're looking at ways to improve your team's close rate. Is that still the main focus?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Yes exactly. We've had a rough quarter — close rate dropped from 28 to 19 percent over six months and I'm getting pressure from the VP to turn that around before end of year.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: That's a meaningful drop. So going from 28 to 19 — what do you think is the biggest single driver? Is it happening at a specific stage in the pipeline?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Mostly at the discovery stage. Reps are moving deals forward without really qualifying them. We don't have visibility into what's being said on calls, so we can't coach at scale.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Got it. And who would ultimately make the call on a solution like this — is that you, or does it involve your VP as well?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: It'd be a joint decision. I can evaluate and recommend, but Sarah Chen — she's our VP of Sales — she'd need to approve the budget. She's very data-driven, so I'd need solid numbers to bring to her.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: That makes sense. What does Sarah's evaluation process typically look like? Does she prefer a live demo, or more of a written business case first?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Usually a pilot first — she likes to see results on real calls before committing. We'd also need a security review from IT, that typically takes two to three weeks.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Perfect. So if we could run a two-week pilot on your team's calls and show a measurable uplift in qualification scores, that would give you what you need to take it to Sarah?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Yes, I think that would work. I can probably get five reps to participate in a pilot.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Great — let me send over the pilot setup doc today and we can get on a call Thursday to align on the cohort. Does 2pm work?
